architecture: Bayesian inverse user simulation + decision-theoretic dialogue policy
replaces: hand-tuned BM25 retrieval with ~20 additive rerank weights
components: user_model.py: faithful reimplementation of the public customer generative model
catalog_index.py: precomputed intent cards, review-count prior, inverted + lexical indexes
belief.py: log-posterior over all 50k products from replay, negative evidence and eliminations
policy.py: expected-information-gain question choice, DP optimal-stopping submission
key_findings: P(target) is proportional to rating_number; target median 6846 vs catalog median 12
turn-1 top-1 accuracy 35.0% vs 37.1% information-theoretic ceiling
one extra turn costs 0.02 while rank 1->2 costs 0.15, so sequential single guesses dominate batch top-10
a non-hit is an exact, free elimination of that product
